passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: Well... I'm glad we're done with that Meone. But there's no sign of Wini here.

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Wilfred: If Wini was going to be anywhere it was here, even mother was here.

[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Meone: Meow? ...Meow...Meow!

[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Wilfred: Meone? You're noisier than usual. Whatever is the matter? Wait, is that Ackergaul's mask?

[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Wilfred: Are you trying to put the mask on? I mean, it does suit you Meone. Here let me help.

[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Meone: Meow!

[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Wilfred: Well, I don't know why you wanted the mask on, but it oddly suits you Meone.

[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Wilfred: Still no sign of Wini though. This was a nice distraction, but we need to find her Meone.

[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Meone?: Maybe I could help you with that? Wow, it's good to be able to talk again.

[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wait... HUH!?

[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Wilfred: Is that you Wini!? Have you become Meone!?

[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 12
passages.text:
Winifred: It's my possession magic brother. Don't you remember?

[[Line 13]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Winifred: I haven't been gone that long. Or have I? I've lost track of time.

[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wait, if you're possessing Meone, then you have to be in this place right?

[[Line 15]]

passages.name: Line 15
passages.text:
Winifred: I don't believe I am, I've made quite the journey to get here you know?

[[Line 16]]

passages.name: Line 16
passages.text:
Wilfred: But if you aren't here, then where are you?

[[Line 17]]

passages.name: Line 17
passages.text:
Winifred: I don't know. I can see that I'm in a room. It's quite a lovely room. Very comfortable.

[[Line 18]]

passages.name: Line 18
passages.text:
Wilfred: That's great Winifred, but you're going to be killed if I don't find you. Comfortable room or not.

[[Line 19]]

passages.name: Line 19
passages.text:
Winifred: Hmmm... let me try to retrace my steps for you.

[[Line 20]]

passages.name: Line 20
passages.text:
Winifred: I found Meone in the room I was stuffed in. I don't know why she was there or how she got there.

[[Line 21]]

passages.name: Line 21
passages.text:
Winifred: But I remember mother possessing her all the time to pull tricks on us. So I thought to do the same.

[[Line 22]]

passages.name: Line 22
passages.text:
Winifred: Minus the tricks of course.

[[Line 23]]

passages.name: Line 23
passages.text:
Wilfred: Ugh... Wini. You always tell these long stories. Just tell me the important bits!

[[Line 24]]

passages.name: Line 24
passages.text:
Winifred: Ah... I'm sorry. So, I got caught as Meone and stuffed in a box. 

[[Line 25]]

passages.name: Line 25
passages.text:
Winifred: There were some voices, and a lot of rattling. I think I was being transported.

[[Line 26]]

passages.name: Line 26
passages.text:
Wilfred: Oh! So you don't know where you are or how you got here? Great, just what I need.

[[Line 27]]

passages.name: Line 27
passages.text:
Winifred: I'm sorry Wilfred. If I knew more, I would tell you. 

[[Line 28]]

passages.name: Line 28
passages.text:
Winifred: Oh wait! I did come out of that room over there.

[[Line 29]]

passages.name: Line 29
passages.text:
Wilfred: Which room? You mean the one where those horse specimens came out of?

[[Line 30]]

passages.name: Line 30
passages.text:
Winifred: Yes. I remember there being lots of boxes. Perhaps there's a clue in there?

[[Line 31]]

passages.name: Line 31
passages.text:
Wilfred: Easy! I've got this Wini. Just don't get in my way.

[[Line 32]]

passages.name: Line 32
passages.text:
Winifred: Ah... I mean have I been in the way at all?

[[Line 33]]

passages.name: Line 33
passages.text:
Wilfred: Uh... not really. But it goes without saying, I'll be the one to save you!

[[Line 34]]

passages.name: Line 34
passages.text:
Winifred: You couldn't have beaten Ackergaul if I hadn't possessed that specimen.

[[Line 35]]

passages.name: Line 35
passages.text:
Wilfred: ...

[[Line 36]]

passages.name: Line 36
passages.text:
Wilfred: (She's not wrong. I couldn't even scratch him on my own.)

[[Line 37]]

passages.name: Line 37
passages.text: Wilfred: (But even then, I need to be the one to do this. But I could use her help a little...)
